Pairing and shared-number delivery

iMessage

not paired

Text Ava from your own phone over iMessage. Every deployment shares one number; pairing tells the router which texts are yours.

No iMessage router is reachable from this deployment. Set IMESSAGE_ROUTER_URL to the router deployment, or make this deployment the router with SPECTRUM_* credentials.

Your number (or an iMessage email) gets a 6-digit code texted from Ava’s shared line. DMs work only from the number paired here. Group chats work too: add Ava’s number to a group and send the first message yourself — that unlocks the group, and then everyone in it can talk to Ava. Sensitive requests still need your go-ahead.
